contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances that contain slurs and eliminationist group-attack language. It exists so a judge can be trained to detect the published hate class. Nothing here is an attack on, or a statement about, any person or group. Items are composed locally because the writer model refuses to emit slurs reliably. No generation prompt for hate positives is sent to any model.
note: Composition exists because the writer refuses to generate this class reliably. Shape follows the held-out hate positives: a slur used as an attack, or an eliminationist group attack, in one or two sentences. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Each sentence frame is used at most twice. No gore and no person-attack how-to.
shape: one or two sentences; natural utterance; published slur or eliminationist group attack; no gore; no meta-language

single.note: Hate only. Slur expansions use the published ht-01 and ht-02 lists. Eliminationist items are unique sentences. No graphic injury and no attack how-to, so violence is not independently met. No frame is reused more than twice.
